items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss binnen eines Monats nach der Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterhöhe eingehen, schriftlich, über das Portal ELSTER oder mündlich zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 19.11.2026, no separate 'zur Post gegeben' date stated, so posting day = 19.11.2026. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 → delivery fiction = 4th day after posting, counting calendar days: 19th=day0, 20th(Fri)=1, 21st(Sat)=2, 22nd(Sun)=3, 23rd(Mon)=4 → deemed delivered Mon 23.11.2026. For tax offices, if that 4th day is a Sat/Sun/holiday it moves to next working day, but Mon 23.11.2026 is a normal working day, so no shift. One-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO starts the day after delivery (§108 Abs.1 AO / §187 BGB) and ends on the day with the same number one month later: 23.11.2026 + 1 month = 23.12.2026, which is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift under §108 Abs.3 AO.
